intuition: For each transaction count, keep the best cash balance after buying and after selling.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate up to k nonoverlapping buy-sell intervals and maximize their total profit.

optimal.approach: Update buy and sell DP states for each transaction; when k is at least n/2, sum all positive daily gains.
optimal.time: O(n k), or O(n) in the unlimited-transactions case

edge_cases: Zero transactions or fewer than two prices yield zero.
When k >= n/2, every profitable rising segment can be captured.
A decreasing sequence remains at zero profit.
